name: @bridge/table-kernel
description: The game-LAW kernel as one dependency-free ESM artifact, for hosts outside the workspace (the native coach app vendors dist/table-kernel.js). Law only: state fold, legality, scoring, vocabulary, skins, challenge logic — NO deciders, NO @bridge/kb, NO node builtins.
//why-relative-engine-imports: src/index.ts reaches @bridge/engine's law modules by RELATIVE path, never the package root: the root index re-exports ./decide, whose decider imports @bridge/kb, whose index exports JsonFileKbStore -> node:fs. One root import and the bundle stops loading in React Native.
//why-handwritten-types: dist/index.d.ts is authored by hand (types/table-kernel.d.ts), not tsc-emitted: emitted declarations reference @bridge/* module specifiers a vendoring host cannot resolve. The law surface is small and stable; when a new export is needed, add it to the entry AND the d.ts.
